reason: A voice interaction plugin for terminal agents that provides speech-to-text input, text-to-speech output, optional reply narration, and audio-card rendering with local-first storage and explicitly configured cloud backends.

summaries.zh: 为终端智能体提供语音转文字、文字转语音、回复朗读和音频卡片展示功能，并优先将音频存储在本地。
summaries.en: Provides terminal agents with speech-to-text input, text-to-speech output, optional reply narration, and audio-card rendering with local-first audio storage.

capabilities: Transcribes existing audio files or microphone recordings into user messages
Synthesizes spoken audio from text and plays it asynchronously
Optionally narrates assistant replies through a per-session voice toggle
Stores audio artifacts as local files and renders audio cards in the web client
Can use explicitly configured cloud speech backends
